SUBLINGUAL SIALADENITIS
Introduction
This is a rare painful non-erythematous swelling of one or both parotid
glands occurring 1-2 weeks following exposure to the aetiologic virus
Mumps (acute non-suppurative)
Epidemiology
- Most common in children aged 6 - 8 years with epidemics occurring
during winter and spring, before the onset of routine vaccination against
measles, mumps and rubella
